run_detection_training: run detectron2 model training with a plain training loop using a config file and optional resume
run_detection_evaluation: run evaluation of a trained detectron2 model on test datasets using a config file
build_evaluator: build an evaluator for a given dataset type like COCO, LVIS, or Cityscapes
build_train_loader: build a detection training data loader from the detectron2 config
build_test_loader: build a detection test data loader from the detectron2 config for inference
